decisions.title: The Living Core motion exception
decisions.summary: Continuous motion is permitted only inside an approved Living Core; Wings, labels, controls and layout remain static and reduced motion uses the exact static twin.

decisions.title: Primary cross-channel type system
decisions.summary: Geist owns display titles, tuned Inter owns body and UI, Instrument Serif is contextual only and IBM Plex Mono is restricted to technical content. Implementation remains post-cutover.

decisions.title: Button and action-control system
decisions.summary: Use the approved 12px control radius, solid-outline-text hierarchy, micro-lift, 48px default height, selective directional icons and named dark/mobile behaviours.

decisions.title: Product-family and commerce behaviour
decisions.summary: Use the five-product family, aligned catalogue, gradient-and-copy territories, static repeated cores, equal family weight and the approved commerce/mobile sequence. The reviewed plate did not approve visual execution.

decisions.title: Centred Living Core family direction
decisions.summary: Preserve the centred hierarchy and five-card family direction while revising mobile. Homepage implementation remains post-cutover and must use approved foundations and expression contracts.

decisions.title: Complete source-gradient library and Living Core expression family
decisions.scope: Gradient sources, aliases, animation and expression masks
decisions.summary: Use 43 supplied PNG IDs, expose 33 unique active cores, preserve ten compatibility aliases, accept MZ-G01 as a source exception and use one shared renderer.

decisions.title: Deep Mineral Living Core finish
decisions.summary: Use the approved Deep Mineral exposure, saturation, contrast, shade, bloom and grain values without changing source palette authority.

decisions.title: Migrate before completing the full system
decisions.summary: Close the identity kernel and minimum canonical engine, cut over once, then build foundations, product expressions, golden outputs, Figma and channels in the standalone repository.

decisions.title: Literal five-product architecture and Living Core assignments
decisions.scope: Product names, stable IDs and gradient assignments
decisions.summary: Use literal names only: AI OS MZ-G13, Context Engine MZ-G12, AI Ads System MZ-G06, Claude Code OS MZ-G15 and Organic Content OS MZ-G20.
